cost_bounds.GPU_training_runtime_estimate: unmeasured for this exact two-reverse composition; CPU lifecycle is not a GPU wall-time estimate
cost_bounds.cost_rule: Preserve all old39 plus6 unique fits (45); old33 plus6 banks (39). Collection and failed engineering costs remain separate. No sums of concurrent peaks/walls.
cost_bounds.memory_admission: Root must reserve explicit GPU/host budgets and allowed peer process identities; no resource claim from low parameter count.

data_role_pins.scope: opaque provider cache integrity only; no tensor load, labels, scoring or model construction

failure_rule: One serial new GPU worker,4h per fit; stop later admission on any failure, timeout or close error; preserve partial costs, no automatic retry/resume. No collection until all6 successful terminal outcomes.

method.initialization: same original fresh native constructor and zero-up rank8 residual/private BN; no warm/engineering state
method.private_credit: weighted W only on original residual down/up
method.shared_credit: original unweighted native F including BN affine and native head
method.weights: unchanged exact TRAIN class/atom-count q; .5+2q; whole-vector within-class seed+7030031 permutation control

native_protocol.native_optimizer: Adam lr0.001 with original defaults; one transition per eligible batch
native_protocol.normalization: exact route-private BN buffers v3, shared native affine, same as reused private-BN controls
native_protocol.train_objective: Original native observed-label mean BCE reduction for every route; shared native parameters receive unweighted F (mean of the four original route losses), while only original residual down/up receive fixed responsibility-weighted W with the same native reduction and no minibatch weight renormalization; no auxiliary loss.

predeclared_readout.BCE: Retain signed native-reduction and uniform-graph BCE separately for every seed and contrast. No posthoc calibration, clipping, loss threshold or readout substitution.
predeclared_readout.I4: Keep genuine I4, M1 and original G0 visible; a primary ingredient signal is not a victory over I4.
predeclared_readout.member_quality: Individual, mean and worst AUC/BCE; no routes or positive-negative pairs treated as independent repetitions.
predeclared_readout.no_tuning: No HPO, extra seed, changed strength/quartiles, selected subset, checkpoint rule, extra fit or alternative aggregation.
predeclared_readout.permuted_minus_uniform: Report generic responsibility effect separately from structural attribution.
predeclared_readout.primary: All signed structured-minus-uniform and structured-minus-permuted AUC pp by seed, with three-seed mean/sample SD only after all6 finish. A positive three-seed mean in BOTH contrasts is the bounded primary AUC signal; no significance/generalization claim.
predeclared_readout.usable_difference_signature: Separately report pool-minus-mean-member AUC change, common member ranking reversals, pool losses despite correct member pairs, and actual repairs of uniform-common reversals versus new harms. Increased disagreement or an oracle union alone is insufficient; AUC benefit without this signature remains a whole-procedure result.

question: Does balanced structural private-risk assignment improve selected served mean-logit VALID AUC over BOTH uniform residual-only and the exact within-class vector permutation, with stronger usable member differences?
